requested_outcome: Transform the existing VII administration area into a premium, easy daily operating system with a clear command center, actionable data, search-content workflow, growth tooling and consistent responsive interaction states while preserving verified capabilities and truthful data boundaries.
natural_destination: The authenticated production administration routes under https://vii.spaplus.co/admin
authorization_boundary: Local implementation and verification are authorized. The standing explicit instruction in the active VII conversation authorizes publication after a versioned rollback-safe release; no supplier pull, purchase, outbound message or unverified integration activation is authorized.

lesson_bundle.reason: The request is specifically for a management system that works as a daily operating product.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require short task paths, operational states, persistence where editing exists, and natural-surface verification.

lesson_bundle.reason: Adir explicitly asked for promotion, search pages, sitemap, analytics and other site controls in one system.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Inventory the CMS and growth capability family and expose honest connected or unavailable states.

lesson_bundle.reason: The dashboard contains business performance and funnel metrics.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Every visible number needs a defined source, period and formula; intent events remain distinct from completed outcomes.

lesson_bundle.reason: The requested system must remain easy and obvious despite broad capability.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Each screen has one current task and dominant action, with advanced tools progressively disclosed.

lesson_bundle.reason: The current complaint is primarily about weak visual quality and hierarchy.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Use a coherent spacing rhythm, remove nested frames and verify desktop and mobile geometry visually.

lesson_bundle.reason: The administration system is used on a narrow viewport and the current mobile shell is dense.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Treat 390px as a primary surface and verify navigation, tables, cards and actions without overflow.

lesson_bundle.reason: All changed administration surfaces are Hebrew.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Use and verify Heebo with modern sans-serif fallbacks on private desktop and mobile routes.

lesson_bundle.reason: The change touches a shared authenticated shell and several operational routes.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Run family regression, build, tests, live authenticated checks and preserve rollback identity.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The home screen looks prettier but the inner administration pages still look like raw developer tables.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Create shared administration primitives and redesign the business-performance, queue and growth surfaces in addition to the shell and home.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Open the dashboard, business performance, content queue and growth center on desktop and 390px mobile and compare hierarchy and interaction states.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The dashboard shows numbers without explaining whether they are impressions, visits, clicks, leads or completed bookings.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Label the funnel stages, period, sources and formulas and keep intent signals separate from saved leads and bookings.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Every KPI and ratio visibly names its scope and the API contract is covered by tests.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The system is comprehensive but overwhelming, with too many equally prominent actions.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use a dominant daily priority area, grouped tools, command search and progressive disclosure.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Each representative screen exposes one dominant next action while all advanced modules remain reachable.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The new mobile administration view overflows or hides important navigation and controls.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use a mobile command header, bottom navigation, horizontal-safe tables and card transformations at 390px.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Live 390x844 checks show zero horizontal overflow and reachable primary controls.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The growth center pretends GA4, Search Console or supplier automation is connected.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Report only locally measured VII data and live public endpoint health; mark external integrations as not connected until verified.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: No connected claim is displayed without a verified API or live endpoint response.

affected_family: authenticated loading, empty, error and unauthorized states
desktop, tablet and 390px mobile administration layouts
overview and performance API response contracts

sources.label: VII administration requirements and implementation truth
Existing search-page command center interaction depth

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the shared shell, command bar and dashboard are implemented before converting the remaining representative operational pages.
checks: dashboard renders from real API data
desktop and 390px first viewport have clear hierarchy and no overflow

attack_questions: Can an authenticated manager identify the single most important next action within five seconds?
Does any metric imply a completed call, WhatsApp send or booking when only an intent event was recorded?
Does any representative administration route retain raw unstyled controls, clipped content or horizontal page overflow at 390px?
Can an unauthorized visitor see any management data?
Did the redesign hide or break any previously verified tool or direct route?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Authenticated live production checks and screenshots of the exact published version on /admin and representative routes.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Build and complete regression suite plus desktop and mobile route matrix for the shared shell, dashboard, growth center, queue and business performance.

effectiveness.baseline: Production version 412 has nine functioning modules, but the home dashboard and multiple operational pages use sparse cards, inline styles, raw tables and inconsistent controls; no unified growth center or command search exists.
effectiveness.target: One coherent administration product with a premium command center, at least four representative polished routes, truthful funnel data, zero page-level horizontal overflow at 390px and all previous routes preserved.
